title: IRS scam: back taxes and an arrest in two hours

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: This is Officer Johnson with the Internal Revenue Service. Am I speaking with Mrs. Díaz?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: You owe $4,800 in back taxes. There is a warrant for your arrest, and the police will come to your house in two hours.

lines.speaker: senior
lines.text: That can't be right. I've always paid my taxes.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: To stop the warrant you must pay today. Go to Walgreens, buy Target gift cards, and call me back with the numbers.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Do not talk to anyone about this case, or it will count as obstruction.
